# NEW 2026-11-18 great houses and themes. Generated by gen_theme_houses.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Theme scope. Which house the strategos belongs to (oe_tg_house = slot, 0 = none).
oe_tg_refresh_house = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    save_scope_as = oe_tg_rt
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tg_house value = 0 }
	    if = {
	        limit = { has_ruler = yes ruler = { has_dynasty = yes } }
	        ruler = { dynasty = { save_scope_as = oe_tg_rdyn } }
	        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
	            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_1 var:oe_nf_dynasty_1 = scope:oe_tg_rdyn } scope:oe_tg_rt = { set_variable = { name = oe_tg_house value = 1 } } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_2 var:oe_nf_dynasty_2 = scope:oe_tg_rdyn } scope:oe_tg_rt = { set_variable = { name = oe_tg_house value = 2 } } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_3 var:oe_nf_dynasty_3 = scope:oe_tg_rdyn } scope:oe_tg_rt = { set_variable = { name = oe_tg_house value = 3 } } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_4 var:oe_nf_dynasty_4 = scope:oe_tg_rdyn } scope:oe_tg_rt = { set_variable = { name = oe_tg_house value = 4 } } }
	        }
	    }
	}
}

# IO scope. Watches house slot $slot$: removal from the roll, and a pressure that started this month.
oe_tg_watch_slot = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_tg_had_$slot$ NOT = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_$slot$ } }
        remove_variable = oe_tg_had_$slot$
        remove_variable = oe_tg_last_inf_$slot$
        if = {
            limit = { c:BYZ = { any_subject = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_tg_house ?= $slot$ } } }
            c:BYZ = {
                every_subject = {
                    limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_tg_house ?= $slot$ }
                    oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -10 }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_tg_house value = 0 }
                }
            }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tg_lost_slot } } set_variable = { name = oe_tg_lost_slot value = $slot$ } c:BYZ = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_tg.2 days = 1 } } }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_$slot$ }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = oe_tg_had_$slot$
                has_variable = oe_tg_last_inf_$slot$
                var:oe_nf_influence_$slot$ <= { value = var:oe_tg_last_inf_$slot$ subtract = 25 }
                oe_tg_new_pressure = yes
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_tg_slight_slot }
                c:BYZ = { any_subject = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_tg_house ?= $slot$ } }
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tg_slight_slot value = $slot$ }
            c:BYZ = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_tg.4 days = 1 } }
        }
        set_variable = oe_tg_had_$slot$
        set_variable = { name = oe_tg_dyn_$slot$ value = var:oe_nf_dynasty_$slot$ }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tg_last_inf_$slot$ value = var:oe_nf_influence_$slot$ }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly.
oe_tg_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
	        oe_tg_watch_slot = { slot = 1 } oe_tg_watch_slot = { slot = 2 } oe_tg_watch_slot = { slot = 3 } oe_tg_watch_slot = { slot = 4 }
	        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_pressure_cooldown } set_variable = oe_tg_saw_pressure } else = { remove_variable = oe_tg_saw_pressure }
	        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_ally_pressure_cooldown } set_variable = oe_tg_saw_allyp } else = { remove_variable = oe_tg_saw_allyp }
	    }
	    every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } oe_tg_refresh_house = yes }
	    oe_tg_story_tick = yes
	}
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_tg_theme_s is the theme. A member of house $slot$ takes over the theme (the author's petition
# steps: oe_npet_accept_3), for 3 Imperial Authority.
oe_tg_appoint = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
	        var:oe_nf_dynasty_$slot$ ?= { ordered_character_in_dynasty = { limit = { oe_tg_candidate = yes } order_by = mil save_scope_as = oe_tg_nominee } }
	    }
	    # v6.7 theme-fix2 (r23 g7 甲 3): the price is charged only when the install took (the theme's ruler is the nominee).
	    if = {
	        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tg_nominee }
	        oe_tg_install = { slot = $slot$ }
	        if = {
	            limit = { scope:oe_tg_theme_s = { has_ruler = yes ruler = scope:oe_tg_nominee } }
	            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -3 } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } }
	        }
	    }
	}
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_tg_nominee takes over scope:oe_tg_theme_s.
# v6.7 theme-fix2 (r23 g7 甲 3): the theme keeps a record of the last attempt for the test log (tb2mglog):
# oe_tg_nflag = the nominee's state before the move (1 general, 2 admiral, 4 heir, 8 regent, summed); oe_tg_fail =
# 0 the install took, 1 the nominee did not reach the theme, 2 he reached it but did not become its ruler (he then
# goes back to the empire instead of staying in the theme as a courtier).
oe_tg_install = {
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tg_displaced
    scope:oe_tg_theme_s = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_tg_nflag value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_tg_nominee = { is_general = yes } } change_variable = { name = oe_tg_nflag add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_tg_nominee = { is_admiral = yes } } change_variable = { name = oe_tg_nflag add = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_tg_nominee = { is_heir = yes } } change_variable = { name = oe_tg_nflag add = 4 } }
        if = { limit = { scope:oe_tg_nominee = { is_regent = yes } } change_variable = { name = oe_tg_nflag add = 8 } }
    }
    scope:oe_tg_theme_s = { ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_displaced } }
    scope:oe_tg_nominee = { move_country = scope:oe_tg_theme_s }
    scope:oe_tg_theme_s = { set_new_ruler = scope:oe_tg_nominee }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { scope:oe_tg_theme_s = { ruler = scope:oe_tg_nominee } } }
        scope:oe_tg_theme_s = { set_variable = { name = oe_tg_fail value = 1 } }
        scope:oe_tg_nominee = {
            if = {
                limit = { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no owner ?= scope:oe_tg_theme_s }
                scope:oe_tg_theme_s = { set_variable = { name = oe_tg_fail value = 2 } }
                move_country = c:BYZ
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_tg_theme_s = { ruler = scope:oe_tg_nominee } }
        scope:oe_tg_theme_s = { set_variable = { name = oe_tg_fail value = 0 } }
        scope:oe_tg_nominee = { add_trait = trait:oe_character_war_score_trait_VI }
        scope:oe_tg_displaced ?= {
            if = { limit = { is_alive = yes NOT = { oe_nf_theme_governor = yes } } remove_trait = trait:oe_character_war_score_trait_VI }
            if = { limit = { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no } move_country = c:BYZ reset_ruler_title = {} }
        }
        scope:oe_tg_theme_s = { set_variable = { name = oe_tg_house value = $slot$ } }
        oe_court_clear_invalid = yes
        oe_court_auto_fill = yes
        oe_nf_refresh = yes
    }
}

# BYZ scope, yearly, AI only: the political ally's man for the most estranged theme.
oe_tg_ai_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    if = {
	        limit = {
	            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { has_variable = oe_nf_political_ally var:oe_pillars_authority >= 8 }
	            any_subject = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty_band var:oe_theme_loyalty_band <= 1 }
	        }
	        ordered_subject = {
	            limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty_band var:oe_theme_loyalty_band <= 1 }
	            order_by = oe_tg_estrangement
	            save_scope_as = oe_tg_theme_s
	        }
	        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
	            if = { limit = { oe_nf_is_political_ally = { slot = 1 } oe_tg_slot_has_candidate = { slot = 1 } } c:BYZ = { oe_tg_appoint = { slot = 1 } } } else_if = { limit = { oe_nf_is_political_ally = { slot = 2 } oe_tg_slot_has_candidate = { slot = 2 } } c:BYZ = { oe_tg_appoint = { slot = 2 } } } else_if = { limit = { oe_nf_is_political_ally = { slot = 3 } oe_tg_slot_has_candidate = { slot = 3 } } c:BYZ = { oe_tg_appoint = { slot = 3 } } } else_if = { limit = { oe_nf_is_political_ally = { slot = 4 } oe_tg_slot_has_candidate = { slot = 4 } } c:BYZ = { oe_tg_appoint = { slot = 4 } } }
	        }
	    }
	}
}

# BYZ scope, right after a strategos has taken the throne (gen_theme_usurp.py). The old dynasty, if it still has a
# grown member in the empire and the roll has room, becomes a house with 300 influence.
oe_tg_after_usurp = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    if = {
	        limit = {
	            exists = scope:oe_tg_old_dynasty
	            has_ruler = yes
	            NOT = { ruler = { dynasty ?= scope:oe_tg_old_dynasty } }
	            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { has_variable = oe_nf_initialized oe_nf_house_count < var:oe_nf_house_limit }
	            scope:oe_tg_old_dynasty = { any_character_in_dynasty = { oe_nf_promotion_character = yes } }
	        }
	        scope:oe_tg_old_dynasty = { random_character_in_dynasty = { limit = { oe_nf_promotion_character = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tg_pretender } }
	        scope:oe_tg_pretender ?= { oe_nf_register = { initial = 300 } }
	        set_variable = { name = oe_tg_deposed value = scope:oe_tg_old_dynasty }
	        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_tg.3 days = 3 }
	    }
	}
}

# BYZ scope. Influence for the story's house (var oe_tg_slot) / second house (oe_tg_slot2).
oe_tg_inf = { if = { limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tg_slot ?= 1 } } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 1 amount = $amount$ } } else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tg_slot ?= 2 } } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 2 amount = $amount$ } } else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tg_slot ?= 3 } } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 3 amount = $amount$ } } else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tg_slot ?= 4 } } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 4 amount = $amount$ } } } } }
oe_tg_inf2 = { if = { limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tg_slot2 ?= 1 } } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 1 amount = $amount$ } } else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tg_slot2 ?= 2 } } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 2 amount = $amount$ } } else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tg_slot2 ?= 3 } } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 3 amount = $amount$ } } else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tg_slot2 ?= 4 } } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 4 amount = $amount$ } } } } }
# BYZ scope. Loyalty for every theme led by the story's house.
oe_tg_house_loy = { if = { limit = { var:oe_tg_slot ?= 1 } every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_tg_house ?= 1 } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = $amount$ } } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tg_slot ?= 2 } every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_tg_house ?= 2 } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = $amount$ } } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tg_slot ?= 3 } every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_tg_house ?= 3 } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = $amount$ } } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tg_slot ?= 4 } every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_tg_house ?= 4 } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = $amount$ } } } }
oe_tg_house2_loy = { if = { limit = { var:oe_tg_slot2 ?= 1 } every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_tg_house ?= 1 } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = $amount$ } } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tg_slot2 ?= 2 } every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_tg_house ?= 2 } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = $amount$ } } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tg_slot2 ?= 3 } every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_tg_house ?= 3 } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = $amount$ } } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tg_slot2 ?= 4 } every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_tg_house ?= 4 } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = $amount$ } } } }
# BYZ scope. Every house on the roll.
oe_tg_all_inf = { if = { limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_1 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 1 amount = $amount$ } } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_2 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 2 amount = $amount$ } } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_3 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 3 amount = $amount$ } } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_4 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 4 amount = $amount$ } } } } }

# BYZ scope. Picks the story's house / second house (min influence $min$) into var oe_tg_slot / oe_tg_slot2.
oe_tg_pick = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    remove_variable = oe_tg_slot
	    random_list = {
	        1 = { trigger = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { oe_tg_slot_ok = { slot = 1 min = $min$ } } } set_variable = { name = oe_tg_slot value = 1 } } 1 = { trigger = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { oe_tg_slot_ok = { slot = 2 min = $min$ } } } set_variable = { name = oe_tg_slot value = 2 } } 1 = { trigger = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { oe_tg_slot_ok = { slot = 3 min = $min$ } } } set_variable = { name = oe_tg_slot value = 3 } } 1 = { trigger = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { oe_tg_slot_ok = { slot = 4 min = $min$ } } } set_variable = { name = oe_tg_slot value = 4 } }
	    }
	}
}
oe_tg_pick2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    remove_variable = oe_tg_slot2
	    random_list = {
	        1 = { trigger = { NOT = { var:oe_tg_slot ?= 1 } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { oe_tg_slot_ok = { slot = 1 min = $min$ } } } set_variable = { name = oe_tg_slot2 value = 1 } } 1 = { trigger = { NOT = { var:oe_tg_slot ?= 2 } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { oe_tg_slot_ok = { slot = 2 min = $min$ } } } set_variable = { name = oe_tg_slot2 value = 2 } } 1 = { trigger = { NOT = { var:oe_tg_slot ?= 3 } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { oe_tg_slot_ok = { slot = 3 min = $min$ } } } set_variable = { name = oe_tg_slot2 value = 3 } } 1 = { trigger = { NOT = { var:oe_tg_slot ?= 4 } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { oe_tg_slot_ok = { slot = 4 min = $min$ } } } set_variable = { name = oe_tg_slot2 value = 4 } }
	    }
	}
}
# BYZ scope, in an event's immediate: rebuild the scopes from the variables.
oe_tg_load = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
	        if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tg_slot ?= 1 } } var:oe_nf_dynasty_1 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_family } var:oe_nf_head_1 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_head } } if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tg_slot ?= 2 } } var:oe_nf_dynasty_2 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_family } var:oe_nf_head_2 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_head } } if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tg_slot ?= 3 } } var:oe_nf_dynasty_3 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_family } var:oe_nf_head_3 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_head } } if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tg_slot ?= 4 } } var:oe_nf_dynasty_4 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_family } var:oe_nf_head_4 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_head } }
	        if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tg_slot2 ?= 1 } } var:oe_nf_dynasty_1 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_family2 } var:oe_nf_head_1 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_head2 } } if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tg_slot2 ?= 2 } } var:oe_nf_dynasty_2 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_family2 } var:oe_nf_head_2 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_head2 } } if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tg_slot2 ?= 3 } } var:oe_nf_dynasty_3 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_family2 } var:oe_nf_head_3 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_head2 } } if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tg_slot2 ?= 4 } } var:oe_nf_dynasty_4 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_family2 } var:oe_nf_head_4 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_head2 } }
	    }
	    var:oe_tg_theme ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_theme_s }
	    scope:oe_tg_theme_s ?= { ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tg_strat } }
	}
}

# Test helper: console 'effect oe_tg_fire = { n = 15 }' (picks a house first; if the story's own pick finds none,
# for instance no house at 400 influence yet, any house will do).
oe_tg_fire = { oe_tg_pick = { min = 0 } oe_tg_pick2 = { min = 0 } oe_tg_prep_$n$ = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tg_slot } } oe_tg_pick = { min = 0 } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tg_slot2 } } oe_tg_pick2 = { min = 0 } } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tg.$n$ }

# BYZ scope, monthly. At most one house story every 8 months, 8 % a month, each once in 20 years.
oe_tg_story_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    if = {
	        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tg_cd } oe_story_gap_open = yes oe_tg_any_house = { min = 0 } }
	        random = {
	            chance = 8
	            set_variable = { name = oe_tg_cd months = 8 }
	            random_list = {
	                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tg_done_10 } oe_tg_any_house = { min = 150 } current_date >= 1347.6.1 } set_variable = { name = oe_tg_done_10 years = 20 } oe_tg_prep_10 = yes oe_story_gap_set = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_tg } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tg value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tg add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tg.10 }
	                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tg_done_11 } oe_tg_two_houses = { min = 150 } any_subject = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty_band var:oe_theme_loyalty_band <= 1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tg_done_11 years = 20 } oe_tg_prep_11 = yes oe_story_gap_set = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_tg } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tg value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tg add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tg.11 }
	                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tg_done_12 } oe_tg_any_house = { min = 0 } any_subject = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_ts_frontier = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_tg_done_12 years = 20 } oe_tg_prep_12 = yes oe_story_gap_set = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_tg } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tg value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tg add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tg.12 }
	                25 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tg_done_13 } has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active oe_tg_any_house = { min = 100 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tg_done_13 years = 20 } oe_tg_prep_13 = yes oe_story_gap_set = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_tg } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tg value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tg add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tg.13 }
	                20 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tg_done_14 } has_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active oe_tg_any_house = { min = 150 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tg_done_14 years = 20 } oe_tg_prep_14 = yes oe_story_gap_set = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_tg } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tg value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tg add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tg.14 }
	                8 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tg_done_15 } oe_tg_any_house = { min = 400 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tg_done_15 years = 20 } oe_tg_prep_15 = yes oe_story_gap_set = yes if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_tg } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tg value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tg add = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tg.15 }
